mx.teacher_note: Winnowing separates otherwise identical white and black beads because white beads travel farther.

intelligence.enrichment: Winnowing separates heavier and lighter components of a mixture by wind or by blowing air. Moving air carries the lighter component farther away while the heavier component falls closer down. The learner correctly applies this rule: Winnowing separates heavier and lighter components of a mixture by wind or by blowing air. Winnowing works because the tray is shaken, so wind is not necessary.
